name: Hakone Pass
geometryNote: BEHAVIOURAL FACSIMILE, NOT A SURVEY. No radius, angle or connector below is a measured fact about the real road. Every number was searched to reproduce driven times, because the model carries no racing-line term and the surveyed road is unlappable without one. Never cite a figure from this array as a fact about Hakone.

name: Wangan Bayshore
geometryNote: BEHAVIOURAL FACSIMILE, NOT A SURVEY, on exactly the footing Hakone is. The corner character (eight fast sweepers, two mediums, one slow junction ramp) and the 7.0 km length come from a description of the road; the radii, angles and connectors were searched to reproduce driven times. Never cite a figure from this array as a fact about the road.

name: Misaki International Raceway
geometryNote: Traced from the circuit's own top view, independent of any fit: fast west-coast run, S-point hairpin, centre lollipop, fast right sweepers, long main straight. It is the only geometry here whose error level measures the model rather than a search.

name: Yatabe Straight
geometryNote: A kilometre from a standstill, no corners. Its segment array is empty deliberately: a zero-angle segment would still enter its straight at an apex speed, making the run a flying kilometre. It is also the one course carrying a calibration offset, applied inside the standing-start evaluator and reaching nothing else.
